part.text: The annotation wrapper is created by Lombok’s shadow-loaded javac classes, while the existing reflection helper compares against a class loaded from another loader. I’ll make that helper resolve annotated-type fields from the runtime tree class when necessary, restoring handling across the shadow class loader boundary.

I identified the loader-boundary issue in `JCAnnotatedTypeReflect`: its strict class identity test fails for Lombok’s shadow-loaded javac AST. The compatibility helper now recognizes the runtime annotated-type class and resolves its underlying type field dynamically.
